style.label: honest first reaction
style.brief: a casual 'I did not expect this' voice-note reaction. Line 1 = what you thought before, line 2 = the one real thing that surprised you. Only say things the product page clearly supports.
style.yt_line: Camera: quick whip-pan reveal, calm and minimal mood.
style.look_extra: Camera: quick whip-pan reveal, calm and minimal mood.
style.ad_brief: AD LEVEL = direct: clearly say what the product is and the one thing that makes it handy. PRICE RULE: do NOT mention any price, cost, discount, offer, 'cheap', 'cheapest' or 'budget' anywhere (no rupee amounts, no Rs, no numbers about money).
style.caption_tone: Keep the caption clear: say what the product is and why it is handy, in 2 to 3 short lines. Do not mention the price.
style.caption_cta: Comment LINK and check your DM for the link
